name: Borrowed Authority
window: ACTION:
windowEffect: Return 1 player's command token from your tactic pool and perform a tactical action in a non-home, non-Mecatol Rex system with no other player's units, using a token from that player's reinforcements.

name: Seize Command
window: When you spend influence to gain 1 or more command tokens:
windowEffect: You may place 1 other player's control token into your tactic pool instead of gaining 1 of those command tokens. You may only have 1 of each player's control tokens in your tactic pool.

name: Diplomatic Immunity
permanentEffect: You do not have to spend a command token to use the secondary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card. Other players cannot place your tokens for the primary effect of Diplomacy.

name: Mandate of Presence
window: When you pass:
windowEffect: You may spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to perform the primary ability of the Diplomacy strategy card.

name: Lobbyist Dues
window: During the agenda phase, if an outcome that you voted for or predicted is not resolved:
windowEffect: Gain commodities equal to the number of players who voted for the outcome that was resolved.

name: Tight Scheduling
window: After the first agenda is revealed:
windowEffect: Draw 3 agendas and place them in your hand. When an agenda would be revealed, you may reveal 1 agenda from your hand instead. At the end of the agenda phase, place the remaining agendas on the bottom of the deck in any order.

name: Echo of the Anvil
window: When you produce 2 or more units:
windowEffect: Reduce the combined cost by 1 if you produced at least 2 units of the same type.

name: Factory Lease
window: During setup, gain the Factory Lease promissory notes. At the start of the agenda phase:
windowEffect: You may produce 1 with a cost of 4 or less in a system containing 1 of your space docks and no other players' ships for each Factory Lease attachment on the game board.

name: Shared Discoveries
window: At the end of a player's tactical action in a non-home system:
windowEffect: You may spend 1 commodity to allow that player to explore a planet in the active system as if it had any planet trait.

name: Expeditionary Cache
window: Legacy:
windowEffect: This retired ability is retained only for existing games.

name: Colony Outposts
window: At the end of a tactical action during which you explored a planet:
windowEffect: You may spend 1 command token to reveal cards from that planet's exploration deck until you reveal an attachment. Resolve that exploration and shuffle the revealed cards back into the deck.

name: Battle-Tested Designs
window: When you research a unit upgrade technology:
windowEffect: you may ignore 1 prerequisite.

name: Evolved Warforms
permanentEffect: Your mechs are treated as both ships and ground forces and gain Move 1. Mechs not being transported count against fleet capacity.

name: Testing Yard
permanentEffect: One ship of each type in your home system does not count against capacity.

name: Ritual of Ascension
window: ACTION:
windowEffect: Purge 2 relic fragments to research 1 technology.

name: Primordial Secrets
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Select 1 primordial technology to play with. You have 1 additional faction technology.

name: Forbidden Knowledge
permanentEffect: The effects of Primordial technologies cannot be used by other players. Primordial technologies have no ability text unless the player using their effect has 4 other technologies of that color, ignoring synergies.

name: Sting of the Hive
permanentEffect:
When you produce 1 or more hits with a unit ability, you may cancel any number of those hits to place that many mine tokens in that system.

After movement, if the active system contains 1 or more of your units, you may remove any number of mine tokens from that system to produce that many hits or gain that many commodities.

name: Hive Echo
permanentEffect: When you would use SPACE CANNON, ANTI-FIGHTER BARRAGE, or BOMBARDMENT, except during SPACE CANNON DEFENSE, in a system containing your ships; A unit with that unit ability up to 2 systems away may use it as if it were in the active system.

name: Ignorant Discoveries
window: At the end of the action phase:
windowEffect: You may purge 1 technology and spend 1 command token from your strategy pool to research 2 technologies.

name: Reflections of the Void
permanentEffect:
When you move units into a system with no planets, you may place 1 reflection token in a system that contains 1 or more planets you control.

At the end of a tactical action in a system that contains 1 or more reflection tokens, you may purge 1 of those tokens to explore the frontier deck in that system.

name: Commanding Presence
window: When you unlock or purge a leader for its effect:
windowEffect: Gain 1 command token.

name: Call of the Haunted
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Purge your alliance promissory note & 1 Revenant Pantheon card. Then, gain each of the leaders on that card. You have 1 additional leader of each type.

name: Allure of Darkness
window: At the start of the strategy phase:
windowEffect: Choose 1 other player's commander that does not have the lich token on it and place the lich token on it.

name: Thrones of Ruin
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Select 1 throne legendary planet and place it in your home system.

name: Traces of Ruin
permanentEffect: Systems that contain throne planets are anomalies. Players may score even if they do not control the throne planets in their home system.

name: Cycle of Reclamation
window: During setup:
windowEffect:
Place the moon phase cards in your play area.

Once per action, except during your tactical actions and whenever you use a unit ability: if a unit is destroyed in a system containing or adjacent to a system containing 1 of your ships, you may capture 1 neutral destroyer.

name: New Moon
window: ACTION:
windowEffect:
Exhaust this card to do 1 of the following:

Place 1 captured neutral unit into a system that contains no other player's ships.

Capture 1 neutral cruiser.

name: Waning Moon
window: When you pass:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 4 or more to research 1 technology.

name: Full Moon
window: At the end of your turn:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 3 or more to place 1 structure on a planet you control.

name: Waxing Moon
window: At the start of your turn:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 2 or more to draw 2 action cards, then discard 1.

name: Lunar Eclipse
window: When you perform a strategic action:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. Return captured neutral units with a combined cost of 2 or more to gain 1 command token.

name: Survivalists
permanentEffect: You may treat your damaged ships as Galvanized during combat.

name: Last Stand
window: When your last unit would be destroyed during the Assign Hits step of combat:
windowEffect:
You may roll that unit's combat dice. For each result equal to or greater than that unit's combat value, produce 1 hit.

If all of your opponent's remaining participating units are destroyed by this roll, your unit is not destroyed.

name: Rallying Cry
permanentEffect: Systems that contain exactly 1 of your non-fighter ships gain PRODUCTION 2 as if they were units.

name: Interlocking Shields
window: Once per combat round, when you cancel 1 or more hits:
windowEffect: Cancel an additional hit.

name: Shielded Transports
permanentEffect: Your non-fighter ships with SUSTIAN DAMAGE gain capacity 1. If they already have a capacity value, increase that value by 1 instead.

name: Enhanced Fundamentals
window: When you win a ground combat:
windowEffect: You may spend 2 trade goods to research a technology with no prerequisites.

name: Custom Rigs
window: During setup:
windowEffect: Choose 2 "Custom Rig" cards to gain. Your units of that type gian those effects and adjust their printed values by those amounts.

name: Drive Decoherence
window: When a player exhausts a custom rig card for its effect:
windowEffect: They must destroy 1 unit of that type at the end of the action.

name: Repurposed Parts
window: Once per combat round, when one of your units is destroyed:
windowEffect: You can produce a unit with a lower cost at a space dock you control.

name: Fragmentum Unleashed
window: When you would purge 1 or more relic fragments:
windowEffect: You may place a corresponding Fragmentum Token on your faction sheet that matches 1 of those fragments.

name: Adaptive
window: During setup:
windowEffect:
Gain each of your components' "Dormant" counterparts. Components with an UNLEASH effect gain the following:
At the start of your turn, you may pay the listed cost and purge this component to gain that component's corresponding "Unleashed" counterpart.
notes: This does not mean you gain your starting techs. Just that you start the game with the "Dormant" versions of all your components.

name: Trovantous
window: At the start of the strategy phase:
windowEffect: Draw 1 random Stoneborn relic fragment.

name: Hydromorphic
permanentEffect: You cannot use the effects of Action Cards. At the start of the strategy phase, draw 2 Action Cards and 2 random "Hydromorphic" cards. Choose 1 Hydromorphic card to keep and return the other to the deck. Hydromorphic cards may be exchanged as part of a transaction.

name: Hydrospheric Extraction
window: Once per action, when you gain control of a planet:
windowEffect: You may destroy 1 of your units on that planet to draw 1 Action Card.

name: Radiant Grafting
window: When your units enter into coexistence on a planet:
windowEffect: Choose 1 Radiant Grafting ability card to gain and place it face up in your play area. At any time you have more Radiant Grafting ability cards than there are planets that have your coexisting units, remove Radiant Grafting ability cards until you do not.

name: Celestial Envoys
window: Once per your strategic actions, when a player performs the secondary ability of that strategy card:
windowEffect: Place 1 infantry into coexistence on a non-home planet that contains their ground forces.

name: Custom Rig: Destroyer
window: When you activate a system:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. During this tactical action, your destroyers have no capacity and you may transport them in your ships with capacity. They do not count against your fleet pool while being transported.
permanentEffect: Passive: -2 COMBAT value.

name: Custom Rig: Cruiser
window: During the "Commit Ground Forces" step:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card to commit any number of your cruisers from the space area of that system to those planets. Return them to the space area at the end of the tactical action
permanentEffect: Passive: COST -1.
notes: This is exhausted at the same time as the other custom rigs, when you activate a system, but its effect is during the "Commit Ground Forces" step. The button won't appear unless you exhaust it beforehand.

name: Custom Rig: Carrier
window: When you activate a system:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card and reduce each of your carriers' capacity by any amount to apply +1 to their movement values for every 2 capacity decreased until the end of this action.
permanentEffect: Passive: SUSTAIN DAMAGE

name: Custom Rig: Dreadnought
window: When you activate a system:
windowEffect: You may exhaust this card. Your dreadnoughts lose SUSTAIN DAMAGE and roll 3 additional dice during BOMBARDMENT and ignore PLANETARY SHIELD.
permanentEffect: Passive: CAPACITY +1.

name: Radiant Grafting: Flight
window: At the end of your tactical actions:
windowEffect: You may place your structures that are in space areas onto planets you control in their respective systems. Blockaded structures in the space area of a system are destroyed.
permanentEffect: Your structures are also ships with MOVE 1 and count against your fleet pool, and cannot use unit abilities while in the space area.

name: Radiant Grafting: Claws
permanentEffect: Your structures are treated as ground forces and gain a COMBAT value of 6 if they do not have it, and they participate in combats that occur where they are placed.

name: Radiant Grafting: Parturition
permanentEffect: Your PDS and Space Docks gain a COST value of 4 and may be produced by your units with PRODUCTION and placed on any planets you control in that unit’s system.

name: Radiant Grafting: Scales
permanentEffect: Your structures gain SUSTAIN DAMAGE if they do not have it. Your structures may use their SUSTAIN DAMAGE ability to cancel a hit that is produced against your ships in their system or ground forces on their planet.

name: Radiant Grafting: Phalanges
permanentEffect: Your mechs gain PRODUCTION 1 and SPACE CANNON 9 and are treated as structures for all purposes.
